cell_type.evidence: Characterization of the riboproteome composition in quiescent cells and post-translational reactivation.
To characterize ribosome heterogeneity during the exit from quiescence, the protein composition of ribosomal particles from stationary phase and nutrient-stimulated cells was assessed.
